summary: readMergingMarkers swallows every readdir error; narrow to ENOENT so an unreadable merging dir refuses instead of reading as no interrupted merge
acceptance: An unreadable <flumeDir>/merging/ escapes readMergingMarkers; an absent one still reads as no markers.
tests: readMergingMarkers throws when the merging dir cannot be read for a reason other than absence
pins: readMergingMarkers reads an absent merging dir as no interrupted merge
notes: src/Dispatcher.ts:636-639. Sibling idiom already shipped at src/priorAttempts.ts:279-283 (ENOENT -> empty, else rethrow); reuse it. Sole consumer is src/cli.ts:982, the loop/job-run startup refusal, where an empty read means start: an EACCES/ELOOP/EIO merging dir proceeds over the unreconciled merge the refusal exists to stop, contradicting this function's own doc block.
